source_status.exact_result: Unverified proof draft: for every complete nontrivially valued K, algebraic valued extension M/K and L=completion(M), every good separated strict boundaryless pure one-dimensional K-analytic X, including singular and nonreduced structure, and every continuous finite h, d'd''[h]=0 iff d'd''[h composed with X_L->X]=0. Every compact ordinary CLD smooth scalar test on X_L exactly descends with compact support to some finite subfield E of M. Finite separable, finite purely inseparable, mixed finite-field decomposition, rational-domain and support dependencies are reconstructed; no prior result or review is a premise.
